Name: Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades (Cobalt-Prismatic-Radioactive)
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b][color=#0000ff]Tool[/color][color=#ff0000] and [/color][color=#9900ff]Sprinkler[/color] [color=#00ff00]Upgrades[/color][/b] combines the tools and sprinklers from from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1723]Cobalt Tools[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7630]Radioactive Tools[/url] into one Mod. It also has a few of my own additions.

Completely rebalanced.

[b]Upgrade Path[/b]
Iridium → Cobalt → Prismatic → Radioactive

[heading]Tool Upgrade Costs[/heading]
[spoiler][b]Iridium → Cobalt[/b]
Cost: 75,000g
Materials: Cobalt Bar ×5

[b]Cobalt → Prismatic[/b]
Cost: 150,000g
Materials: Prismatic Bar ×5

[b]Prismatic → Radioactive[/b]
Cost: 250,000g
Materials: Radioactive Bar ×5[/spoiler]
[heading]Bar Recipes[/heading]
[spoiler][b]Cobalt Bar:  Unlocks once you have at least one Iridium-level tool.[/b]
Iridium Bar ×
Refined Quartz ×5
Coal ×5

[b]Prismatic Bar:  Unlocks once you have at least one Cobalt-level tool.[/b]
Cobalt Bar ×2
Prismatic Shard ×1

[b]Radioactive Bar
[/b]Uses the vanilla Radioactive Bar[/spoiler]
[heading]Tool Enhancements[/heading]
[spoiler][b]Cobalt[/b]
Axe: Refunds 10% of energy spent.
Pickaxe: Refunds 10% of energy spent.
Hoe: Refunds 10% of energy spent and can charge up to 25 tiles.
Watering Can: Refunds 10% of energy spent and can charge up to 25 tiles.
Fishing Rod: One Bait slot and Two tackle. Adds 1 fishing level.
Pan: Can find 7 to 13 ores and up to 5 special items from panning.

[b]Prismatic[/b]
Axe: Refunds 20% of energy spent.
Pickaxe: Refunds 20% of energy spent.
Hoe: Refunds 20% of energy spent and can charge up to 30 tiles.
Watering Can: Refunds 20% of energy spent and can charge up to 30 tiles.
Fishing Rod: One Bait slot and Two tackle. Adds 2 fishing levels.
Pan: Can find 8 to 14 ores and up to 6 special items from panning.

[b]Radioactive[/b]
Axe: Refunds 40% of energy spent and chops fully-grown trees, small stumps, fruit trees, and axe resource clumps in 1 hit.
Pickaxe: Refunds 40% of energy spent and breaks stones and ore nodes in 1 hit.
Hoe: Refunds 40% of energy spent and can charge up to 35 tiles.
Watering Can: Refunds 40% of energy spent and can charge up to 35 tiles.
Fishing Rod: One Bait slot and Two tackle. Adds 3 fishing levels.
Pan: Can find 9 to 15 ores and up to 7 special items from panning.[/spoiler]
[heading]Sprinklers[/heading]
[spoiler][b]Cobalt Sprinkler[/b]
Recipe: Cobalt Bar ×1, Iridium Sprinkler ×1
Unlocks with the [b]Cobalt Bar[/b] recipe.
Waters 48 tiles
With Pressure Nozzle: waters 80 tiles
[b]
Prismatic Sprinkler[/b]
Recipe: Prismatic Bar ×1, Cobalt Sprinkler ×1
Unlocks with the [b]Prismatic Bar[/b] recipe.
Waters 120 tiles
With Pressure Nozzle: waters 168 tiles
[b]
Radioactive Sprinkler[/b]
Recipe: Radioactive Bar ×1, Prismatic Sprinkler ×1
Unlocks with the [b]Radioactive Bar recipe[/b].
Waters 224 tiles
With Pressure Nozzle: waters 288 tiles[/spoiler]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url].
Tool enchantments work normally.
Pressure Nozzles and Enrichers use vanilla behavior.
[heading]Retexture Support[/heading]
Retexture mods can patch the public texture targets below:

Mods/ThaleTheGreat.ToolAndSprinklerUpgrades/Cobalt
Mods/ThaleTheGreat.ToolAndSprinklerUpgrades/Prismatic
Mods/ThaleTheGreat.ToolAndSprinklerUpgrades/Radioactive
[b]
[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b][/b]
